text:
Type: set of three clear glass vases
Use: holding flowers, branches, candles or decorative fillers on a dining table, sideboard or shelf; living room, dining room
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: clear glass with thick flat bases
Colors: transparent clear glass
Shape: three straight-sided cylindrical vases in graduated heights, from a wide short one to a tall slender one, plain rims, easy to group together
Feel: clean, airy, versatile
Goes with: any palette, white or wood surfaces, candles, greenery; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: CYLINDER
product.description: Can be stacked inside one another to save room when storing.
